# fabBoard

> fabBoard is a free, open-source desktop program for Windows (10 and 11) that puts a decision board between you and your AI. You write tasks on the board, the AI (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, Mistral or a local model) works in the project folder, and it puts its questions with options and a recommendation on the board. You click an answer, and the AI implements it. Several projects can run at the same time, each with its own AI.

Key facts:
- Free, MIT licence, source code on GitHub
- Windows 10 and 11; Mac planned
- Works with Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, Mistral or a model on your own computer; the AI can be chosen per project
- Setup without prior knowledge: the AI is installed with one click, no administrator rights, no command line
- Data stays local as plain files; no account, no telemetry
- Interface in German and English, light and dark mode
- Made by Fabian Diering, Berlin, Germany
